inappropriate_unit_interpretations: Treating the 5 training seeds as 5 independent human subjects.
Reporting a seed-based standard deviation as a population confidence interval.
Claiming population-level generalization from 3 held-out subjects.
audits.recommended_reporting: Report seed mean +- sample SD (ddof=1) labeled SEED_VARIABILITY; report the 3 per-subject deltas descriptively; never compute an inferential interval at n=3.

audits.true_population_unit: held-out subject (n=4: s2, s9, s14, s20)
inappropriate_unit_interpretations: Treating the 5 training seeds as 5 independent human subjects.
Treating the aggregate negative direction as evidence the second PPG site is globally harmful - it is n=4-subject, s2-dominated evidence.
Computing any bootstrap or percentile interval at n=4 and presenting it as inferential.
audits.recommended_reporting: Report seed-level direction count (5/5 favor baseline) separately from subject-level direction count (2/4 favor candidate); label subject-level spread NO_DEFENSIBLE_POPULATION_CI; always disclose the s2 sensitivity/flip.

inappropriate_unit_interpretations: Treating 5 training seeds as 5 independent subjects.
Treating 5 sleep-stage classes as 5 independent statistical replicates (they are different sub-tasks with different base rates, not repeated measures of one effect).
Claiming the primary result is uniform across subjects when it is concentrated in SC4011.
audits.recommended_reporting: Report seed mean +- sample SD (ddof=1); report all 3 per-subject deltas, explicitly flagging single-subject dominance; report per-class F1 descriptively without treating classes as a hypothesis-test family.

audits.true_population_unit: held-out subject (n=8: SC4181..SC4251), SAME dataset/protocol as primary
inappropriate_unit_interpretations: Pooling primary (n=3) and secondary (n=8) into a single n=11 headline test set.
Describing the secondary holdout as independent-dataset or population-level replication - it is the same Sleep-EDF cassette source.
Treating the descriptive subject bootstrap (results/sleep_edf_sensitivity_day11.json) as a population-generalization proof.
audits.recommended_reporting: Report primary and secondary separately, always. A descriptive subject bootstrap (label DESCRIPTIVE_SUBJECT_BOOTSTRAP) is permitted at n=8 as a spread summary only.

audits.true_population_unit: held-out subject (n=3, same primary split) for subject-level interaction; seed for seed-level interaction
inappropriate_unit_interpretations: Treating +0.0031 +- 0.0434 (n=5 seeds) as a precise point estimate rather than a noisy, unresolved signal.
Concluding 'no interaction exists' from a null/near-zero mean at this sample size (absence of evidence is not evidence of absence).
audits.recommended_reporting: Report the interaction term's mean, sample SD, median, and sign count together; classify as approximately_additive_or_unresolved, never as a firm additive or synergistic conclusion.

audits.true_population_unit: perturbation condition (114 conditions, some with 5 stochastic seeds), single subject S14
inappropriate_unit_interpretations: Treating 114 conditions as 114 independent subjects or as statistical replicates of a single robustness claim.
Generalizing S14's robustness profile to all subjects.
Calling this 'robust' in an unqualified, population-level sense.
audits.recommended_reporting: Report per-condition MAE/availability descriptively; never compute a single aggregate 'robustness score' across conditions; always disclose the single-subject (S14) scope.

cross_cutting_rule: No training seed is ever treated as an independent biological/population replicate anywhere in this project's artifacts or paper-facing text.
